_comment: SAMPLE harvest: grabs a few representative crime + human-services indicator groups across ALL 7 geography types (Counties, 2010 Census Tract, ZIP, Township, 2010 Blockgroup, School Corporation, MSA). Purpose: see what data exists at every geo level before returning to the full harvest. Reuses the SAME output/state as harvest.config.json / harvest.priority.json so nothing is re-scraped (already-done Counties/Tract combos are skipped; the 5 new geo levels are brand-new chunkKeys). Scope is bounded by includePaths = 14 hand-picked groups (2 per category). To return to the full/priority harvest, just relaunch with that config.
_reportingTargets_note: NOVEL geo levels listed FIRST so the sample surfaces the data we don't yet have (ZIP/Township/Blockgroup/School/MSA) before re-touching Counties/Tract (which we already have plenty of). Reordering is resume-safe: chunkKey embeds the level, so order only changes processing sequence, never keys/dedup.
